Puzzle Quest Vol. 1 — where it all begins

A Bedtime Dream Adventure — Solve Puzzles to Save the Star Garden!

Tonight, when you fall asleep, you'll climb aboard the Dreamland Rocketship. High above the clouds floats the Star Garden — but the grumpy Gloomlings are turning the dream gloomy, and the crops need your help. Read the story, solve the puzzles, defeat the Big Gloom, and wake up from the best dream ever.

  • 8 illustrated bedtime story chapters
  • 24 easy puzzles — word searches, mazes & scrambles
  • 8 full-page coloring pages
  • Meet-the-Crops guides with real vegetable facts
  • Full solutions in the back
  • Large print — made for early readers
The Star Garden crew

Meet the Cosmic Crops

Eight real vegetables with cosmic powers. They're the heroes of every Puzzle Quest adventure — and they pop up all through the coloring books, too.

One series, seven worlds

Where will you color next?

Each coloring volume lands in a brand-new world — inside a drop of pond water, under the sea, up in the clouds, down in the crystal caves. Forty single-sided pages every time.

About the author

John Dank & The Garden

Cosmic Crops is written and created by John Dank and published by Power Scope LLC. What started as one coloring book of cosmic vegetable characters grew into two complete ten-book series — coloring adventures for the whole family, and Puzzle Quest bedtime stories that sneak in vocabulary, spelling, problem-solving, and real vegetable facts.

John also writes fiction: The Garden, his novel, is available in hardcover in the same shop. Follow along with new pages, colored artwork from readers, and the next harvest on social:
